title: Inverses of Fibonacci and Lucas Numbers via Rational Indices
summary: Fibonacci and Lucas numbers have been extensively studied in various algebraic and number-theoretic contexts, including their modular inverses and generalizations. Motivated by these developments, we study the inverses of Fibonacci and Lucas numbers with rational indices through the codenominator function $F$. Uludağ and Gökmen (2022) showed that the rational-indexed Fibonacci number $F_X$, where $X\in\mathbb{Q}_{>0}$, can be expressed using $F$, and that infinitely many such representations exist.
